decisions.reason: As a recent launch that fits the firm's marking portfolio, in a growing industry and within an expanding large firm with R&D and slack, it would likely be retained absent clear evidence of performance below aspiration, though its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat higher risk than the printers.

This printer is very close to the core offer and strategically supports the firm's customized coding solutions, so with no sign of underperformance and with organizational slack the firm would likely keep it on the market.

Because it is adjacent to the established business and supports broader identification and traceability offerings, a large growing German machinery firm would likely continue it unless results clearly disappointed, though some overlap with other inkjet options raises the risk slightly.
